name: Youth Employment Services (WIOA paid work experience)
what_you_do: You can get paid work experience with a local employer, plus help with job searches, resumes, interviews, and school or training options.
who_can_apply: Ages 17 to 24, living in Yolo County, and not in school right now, per the program page. The page names foster care, homelessness, disabilities, parenting, leaving high school, and justice involvement as challenges the program serves.
pay_detail: Paid work experience. The pay rate and number of hours are not stated on the page.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page. Contact the Workforce Development Program Manager to check eligibility and enrollment.
how_to_apply: Contact the Workforce Development Program Manager at the Administrative Offices, (530) 757-5558, or drop by free office hours on Wednesdays from 3 to 6 p.m. at 2455 West Capitol Ave, #118, West Sacramento, CA 95691.
notes: Only the 17-year-old end of this guide's 13 to 18 range is covered. The page does not say whether a California work permit is needed for participants under 18, so ask. Older YCCA posts mention up to 300 paid hours; that figure is not on the current page and is not used here. Narrower and competitive: it is aimed at young people facing barriers and out of school.
